notes.title: Reptiles: In Hunt - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/f798884e1fd156792c02130c5d2b7c27272dc35d.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Hunters![/h3]

Big news today! While we are incredibly thankful for your patience, we want to announce that the wait is finally over! [b]Reptiles: In Hunt[/b] will officially release next month, on [b]July 29, 2021[/b]! 

[h3]Thank you![/h3]

We are extremely thankful to all the beta-testers who have helped with the testing in recent months. Over [b]500 beta-keys[/b] were given out and we were happy to see such an interest in our game! Due to your feedback, we have managed to find key elements that required additional attention - mainly related to the UI and navigation around the maps. 

[h3]What now?[/h3]

Several new improvements in those areas were implemented and we hope that you will have a great time upon release the next month. Although Reptiles: In Hunt is an indie game, made by a small studio consisting of only a few people, we did gave it our best. And we hope that our passion will be visible to you through our game!

Best regards,
Reptiles: In Hunt Team

notes.title: Closed Beta Summary - thank you for participation!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/a8a61e14f8321d51590e551b198353ed8ac502c2.png[/img]

Greetings, Hunters!

We are truly thankful for your participation and interest in our closed beta. We have sent 500 beta keys and we had to close the beta registration due to on-going interest. Your support, kind words, all the small reviews and YouTube videos inspire us to keep up the work and polish this game as much as possible. Thank you!

Of course we are aware that there is still a lot of work ahead of us. That's why we have decided to prioritize fixing some aspects of the game, accordingly to your feedback. In the next few months, we will focus on the following elements:
[list]
[*] Introducing UI elements that will help players finding a correct path to their next objective.
[*] Improving animations dynamics and fluidity. 
[*] Improving gameplay dynamics with the main focus being the combat dynamics.
[*] Improving and adjusting sound volume and sound quality.
[*] Fixing all of the bugs that are preventing players from having a normal, stable gameplay. 
[/list]

Stay tuned for the next updates! 

Best Regards, 
Reptiles: In Hunt Team

notes.title: The hunter and his drone - Dev-Blog Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello hunters! Today we want to talk about a drone in the game.[/h3]

As a hunter, we can use a drone during our hunting. In the world destroyed by the Reptilians, many devices of the old civilization remain and are still operational. Most people avoid such devices and treat it like the magic of the ancients. Some people in the villages adopt the old generators, batteries for lighting. Hunters have found that the drones can be helpful in hunting. Drones are extremely rare and valuable. You have to pay a lot of money for them. Fortunately, the hunters are not among the poor in the village community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/09a7a3a034912b949410d2fb1b9ef17145f24dcb.jpg[/img]

Before the Reptilians ruined the world, humans had perfected the Ni-MH battery manufacturing process. As a result, they retain energy to this day and are completely resistant to weather conditions. Usually, hunters charge their drones with generators in villages, but they can use batteries found in wrecks when hunting.

Using a drone in-game is extremely helpful. By releasing the drone, you can track the nearby loot. In addition, the drone informs us about objects that can be used for climbing or the trails that interest us. If you don't want to get lost in the game, use the drone often and recharge it by collecting batteries.

notes.title: Tools that support our vision - Dev-Blog Update.
notes.notes:
Reptiles: In Hunt runs on the popular game engine - Unity. we are able to get excellent graphics and performance thanks to the techniques used in AAA games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/304751880c39f60592caf905ce89e904a885014c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Environment [/h2]
The game offers rich and detailed vegetation. This effect is achieved, by using GPU instanced grass. This means that we are able to render a large amount of grass without losing the game's performance. Custom grass and trees shaders add a translucency effect to the leaves and grass.
 
Another technique to add more detail is 3d sprites - impostors. This technique is used for large objects like rocks in the far distance. Impostors are 2-dimensional sprites, which look like 3d models. They maintain perspective and react to light. Thanks to this technique we can generate very dense and detailed far plans with many plants in the game.

[h2]Physics[/h2]
Another interesting technique taken from AAA games is an active ragdoll. Thanks to this technique we can mix death animation with physics. A common problem of using death animation itself is the collision with a random wall. Such a model can penetrate it. Pure ragdoll may be unrealistic or may cause to fire model into space when in contact with a wall. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/aa6330a49d709dde0fb2dadb4ca77143eea70a67.gif[/img]

[h2]Animations[/h2]
In the production of Reptiles: In Hunt, we use many external tools to support our work. One of these tools is UMotion, which allows us to create advanced animations directly in the game engine. 
This increases our effectiveness in working with animations.

notes.title: How the Reptilians destroyed our civilization - Dev-Blog Update.
notes.notes:
[h2]Ancient times[/h2]
When the Earth was ruled by dinosaurs and the human species did not yet exist, the Reptilians visited our planet. It was an alien civilization that created life on this planet. They treated our planet like a safari, a big larder with food for their people. Dinosaur meat was their treat. They came to our planet on a great hunt and flew away. When a huge meteorite hit our planet and the dinosaurs slowly died out, our planet was no longer interesting to the Reptilians.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/dab6b29448d52e774759b90041369e4809be3e4b.jpg[/img]

[h2]First contact[/h2]
Millions of years later, their planet met the same fate. The Reptilian civilization was almost completely destroyed by a huge meteorite, and a few Reptilians escaped to another planet that allowed them to live. That planet was Earth. The Reptilians were very surprised that on our planet, intelligent beings evolved, and their civilization was exceptionally strong. The aliens, fearing death at the hands of humans, blended into the crowd. Thanks to advanced technology they were able to deceive human senses and were unrecognizable. They lived quite simply among humans, but their goal was to take control of humans and ultimately be the dominant species. Unfortunately, the Earth's climate made the Reptilians completely infertile. The only possibility was to transform a human child into a Reptiliana with a genetic change. They could have done this, but the disappearing children were a source of concern, and this could lead to the discovery of the secret about the Reptilians who were hiding among them. They chose to manipulate people to destroy them and take control of Earth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/732dbae9bb28a4c52f79f1b17239dc06cccacc45.jpg[/img]

[h2]Great war with Reptilians[/h2]
For centuries, the Reptilians have slowly taken over power in key state positions. When, in the end, despite their small population, they possessed a power that could destroy humanity, they attacked. The nuclear bombs were fired to kill as many people as possible without completely destroying the planet. The Reptilians, thanks to their innate resistance to radiation, were finally able to rule the Earth, and the human survivors were forced to hide in the sewers. 

[h2]Brave New World[/h2]
100 years after the annihilation, their technology surpassed that of humans, and their only problem was still fertility. They also recreated the extinct dinosaurs, which quickly spread throughout the planet. The apocalypse caused an increased greenhouse effect, resulting in increased vegetation and a more tropical climate. When  the radiation stopped being dangerous to people, they went to the surface and started to build villages and small settlements. The Reptilians still can't deal with fertility. They're still hunting  young people turning them into Reptilians and murdering adult people.

notes.title: Exploring the world - Dev-Blog Update
notes.notes:
To enhance the credibility of the world, we've created a variety of locations for the game. The game is set in a half-open world and we tried to create beautiful and reliable places. The world was destroyed almost immediately by an alien race that pretends to be one of us. The Reptilians, who have taken all key positions, lunched rockets at all the world's major cities, pushing people underground. Hundred years later nature took its place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/0183435123ca95e56a5ad22b6c8c6503c925e648.jpg[/img]

Some of the game locations are pure nature with almost no sign of human architecture. Some were not fully destroyed. People who came out of the underground were avoiding these areas. Ancient ruins were abandoned and magical for humans that forgot old technologies and culture. It was also very dangerous. It was a favorite shelter for predators like velociraptors. Only seasoned hunters and gatherers venture into these areas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/a3238376e6c5e10a72ad0ad54061d8d25b010ef8.jpg[/img]

All our locations were designed very carefully to get proper mood and lighting. Nature locations are filled with dinosaurs, pteranodons, birds, and cranes. The dense forest can also hide the mysteries of the past.
